title: 第二章 分秒
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

车子驶出地下车库的时候，林越扫了一眼后视镜。

镜子里是公司大楼的玻璃幕墙，在午后阳光里反射着刺眼的白光。十二层，A座，他在这里上班上了三年。末世爆发后第七天，这栋楼会在燃气泄漏引发的爆炸中塌掉一半，把所有没来得及带走的东西——工位、文件、绿萝、没喝完的速溶咖啡——全部埋在钢筋混凝土下面。包括老周的尸体。他在末世第三天死在了从公司到家的路上。

林越收回视线，把方向盘往右打满，汇入主干道。

他要去的第一个地方是城东的万邦仓储超市。那地方前世在末世初期是兵家必争之地——整整两万平米的仓库，从食品到日用到建材应有尽有。末世第一周，五拨人在门口火并，最后谁都没拿到，因为第七天整片区域被尸潮淹了。但他今天不是去抢物资的。他前世亲眼见过那个仓库的库存清单——在安全区的情报档案里，那份清单被当作“未能获取的重要战略资源”归档了。他只需要验证一件事：那些东西现在还在不在。

车子经过十字路口的时候，林越看了一眼车载导航上的时间。14点58分。还不到晚高峰，路上的车不算太多。他给手机充上电，

“2025年9月12日，14点58分。确认事项：第一批感染症状出现在9月15日下午17点以后，时间误差不超过两小时。零号病例的位置在城南国际机场T3航站楼，国际到达出口。感染方式是体液接触，第一个被咬的人会在约九小时后出现症状，然后——”

他停了一下。

然后这条街、这个区、这座城市，会在十二个小时之内变成地狱。

林越把这些细节全部记下来。前世的记忆是一笔账，五年的末世经验是另一笔账。这两笔账他都要一分不漏地带回这一世。

15点06分，车停在万邦仓储超市的停车场。

林越下车，没有锁车门——这个习惯前世养了五年，刚重生还没改过来。他走了一步才意识到，转身锁了车，然后大步走进超市。

工作日下午的仓储超市人很少。空调开得很足，广播里放着节奏轻快的流行歌，生鲜区的水雾喷头发出规律的呲呲声。林越推了一辆购物车，没有在食品区和日用品区停留，直接穿过整片货架，走到了最里面。

建材区。

他站在那排货架前，目光从第一格扫到最后一格，然后嘴角动了一下。

东西还在。

工业级防尘口罩，五十只装，整整三箱。高标号水泥，十二袋。钢筋捆扎丝，一大盘。还有三台小型汽油发电机，每台标价四千二，摆在货架最底层，落了一层薄灰，显然很久没人动过了。这些是普通人日常根本不会看第二眼的东西，但末世第三天开始，一袋水泥能换半条命。

林越从口袋里掏出手机，对着货架拍了照。然后他西、数量多少。从建材区到五金区到户外用品区，他花了整整四十分钟，把整个超市的可用物资分布图刻进脑子里。仓库后面的卸货区门锁是老式的插芯锁，一把撬棍就能解决。物流通道直通后巷，后巷宽三米，能过一辆轻型卡车。

他站在卸货区门口，在心里推演了一遍。末世爆发后的前十二个小时是整个城市最混乱的窗口期，没人顾得上抢超市，所有人都往医院和政府大楼跑。那是他动手的最好时机。用一辆卡车，带五个人，一个小时之内能搬空建材区和一半的五金区。

“先生，您需要帮忙吗？”

林越转身。一个穿着超市制服的年轻员工正看着他，眼神里带着几分警惕。这个人在建材区站了快四十分钟了，光看不买，还一直在拍照，在仓储超市的安保手册里，这种行为叫“踩点”。

“踩点”这个判断是准确的。只是这个员工不可能猜到，他踩的是末世的点。

“不用，谢谢。”林越说，语气平静，“我在帮公司做采购预算，需要实地核对库存。”

他把手机屏幕翻过来给对方看了一眼——上面确实是他刚才做的物资清单。员工脸上的警惕稍微松了一点，但还是多看了他两眼才走开。林越没有在意。还有58个小时，这个员工就算报警备案，也来不及查他了。

15点50分，林越离开超市，开车回家。

他的住处是公司附近的一间出租公寓，一室一厅，四十二平米，月租两千三。推开门的时候，玄关的灯还亮着——早上出门忘记关了。前世他也总是忘记关灯，苏沐晴为这事说过他好几次。她说你一个月的电费够买三箱泡面，末世之前他不当回事，末世之后他再也没有电灯可以浪费了。

林越站在玄关，环视这个房间。沙发上扔着昨天换下来的T恤，茶几上放着半瓶可乐和一本翻到一半的悬疑小说，厨房水池里泡着两个碗。这是一个二十六岁普通上班族的正常生活痕迹，散漫、安逸、毫无防备。他看着这些，感觉像是在看另一个人的生活。某种意义上，确实是另一个人。

他走进卧室，从衣柜深处翻出一只落满灰尘的登山包。拉开拉链，把里面的东西全倒出来——旧运动鞋、几件速干衣、一个睡袋、一把瑞士军刀。这些都是他前世上大学时玩户外时攒的装备，工作以后再也没用过。他把能用的挑出来，剩下的扔掉，然后把包放在门口。

然后是钱。

林越用卡可用额度五万，一张定期存单八万，还有他工作三年攒下的全部积蓄——一个理财账户里有十二万。加在一起，不到三十万。这点钱在正常情况下不少，但要支撑他接下来要做的事情，远远不够。

他需要一笔更大的钱。

林越车时认识的二手车商，专做抵押车和急售车，路子野，什么车都收，不问来路，不查手续，现金交易。前世末世爆发后老孙死得很早——他在病毒爆发第二天开着一辆刚收的抵押车想跑出城，在高速入口被军方拦下，不是因为病毒，是因为那辆车背着一桩经济纠纷，系统里挂了一年多了。当时场面混乱，执勤的士兵精神高度紧张，他吵了几句，被一枪打中胸口，死在驾驶座上。

那是末世第二天。林越当时不在现场，是后来听一个从高速口逃回来的幸存者说的。

“老孙。”电话接通，林越直接开门见山，“我有辆车要卖。今年年初提的，白色，自动挡，里程一万六。无事故，手续齐全。一口价，八万。明天之前必须成交。”

电话那头老孙愣了一下，然后笑起来：“林哥，八万？你那个车新车落地多少钱你心里没数？一口价你也不能把我当冤大头啊。六万，我今天就给你打钱。”

“七万五。我今天就要。”

“七万。不能再多了。你这车我收回去还得整备，再倒一手，也就赚个辛苦钱。七万，今天晚上转账，明天你来提车？”

“可以。”林越没有跟他纠缠，“但我不去你店里。你把合同带上，今天晚上八点，到我楼下。我当面签，当面交钥匙。”

“成。”老孙痛快地答应了，“不过林哥，你这突然急着卖车，是遇上什么事了？”

林越没有回答。他挂了电话。

15点30分，他开始打电话给二手房中介，挂牌出售老家那套父母的房子。那套房子在邻市，是父母留给他唯一的遗产，他毕业之后一直没住过，出租给一家三口，每个月收点租金补贴房贷。中介接电话的时候语气是惊喜的——这种急着出手的业主他们最喜欢，价格好压。但林越没有给他们压价的机会。

“底价六十万，不商量。三天内能付全款的我优先签，不能的免谈。房源今天下午就上架，明天安排集中看房，我不管你怎么操作，周一之前我要拿到钱。”

“林先生，这个时间确实太紧了，您这个户型在那边市场价——”

“六十万。你卖得掉就拿中介费，卖不掉我找别人。”

“好好好，我马上安排。”

林越挂了电话，在心里快速算了一笔账。七万车款加四万七的工资余额，十一万七。老家房子如果能按预期出手，周一之前能有六十万到账。加上信用卡和理财账户，他的战时流动资金大概在八十多万。这笔钱在三天之内要全部花出去，全部变成物资。

还不够。

但他没有更多可以变现的东西了。

Page (1/3)

When the car drove out of the underground garage, Lin Yue glanced at the rearview mirror.

In the mirror is the glass curtain wall of the company building, reflecting the dazzling white light in the afternoon sun.Twelfth floor, Tower A. He has been working here for three years.On the seventh day after the apocalypse breaks out, half of this building will collapse in an explosion caused by a gas leak, burying all the things that have not been taken away in time - workstations, documents, pothos, unfinished instant coffee - all under the reinforced concrete.Including Lao Zhou’s body.He died on the way from the company to his home on the third day of the apocalypse.

Lin Yue withdrew his gaze, turned the steering wheel all the way to the right, and merged into the main road.

The first place he went to was the Wanbang Warehouse Supermarket in the east of the city.In the previous life, that place was a battleground for military strategists in the early days of the apocalypse - a total of 20,000 square meters of warehouses, with everything from food to daily necessities to building materials.In the first week of the apocalypse, five groups of people fought at the door, but no one got it in the end because the entire area was flooded by the zombies on the seventh day.But he was not there to grab supplies today.He had personally seen the inventory list of that warehouse in his previous life - in the intelligence files of the safe zone, that list was filed as "important strategic resources that could not be obtained".He only needed to verify one thing: those things were still there.

When the car passed the intersection, Lin Yue glanced at the time on the car navigation system.14:58.It's not even the evening rush hour yet, so there aren't too many cars on the road.He charged his mobile phone,

"September 12, 2025, 14:58. Confirmation: The first batch of infection symptoms appeared after 17:00 on September 15th, with a time error of no more than two hours. The location of case zero is at the T3 terminal of Chengnan International Airport, international arrivals exit. The mode of infection is contact with body fluids. The first person bitten will develop symptoms about nine hours later, and then--"

He paused.

And then this street, this district, this city, will turn into hell within twelve hours.

Lin Yue wrote down all these details.The memory of the previous life is one account, and the five years of apocalyptic experience is another account.He will bring these two accounts back to this life without missing a beat.

At 15:06, the car parked in the parking lot of Wanbang Warehouse Supermarket.

Lin Yue got out of the car without locking the door - a habit he had practiced for five years in his previous life and had yet to change when he was reborn.He took a step before realizing it, turned around, locked the car, and strode into the supermarket.

There are very few people in the warehouse supermarket on weekday afternoons.The air conditioner is turned on full blast, brisk pop songs are playing on the radio, and the water mist nozzles in the fresh food area make a regular squeaking sound.Lin Yue pushed a shopping cart, without stopping in the food and daily necessities areas, and walked directly through the entire shelf to the innermost part.

Building materials area.

He stood in front of the row of shelves, his eyes swept from the first frame to the last, and then the corners of his mouth moved.

The things are still there.

Industrial grade dust masks, 50 pieces in three boxes.High-grade cement, twelve bags.Steel bar binding wire, a large plate.There are also three small gasoline generators, each with a price tag of 4,200. They are placed at the bottom of the shelf, covered with a thin layer of dust. Apparently no one has touched them for a long time.These are things that ordinary people would never take a second look at on a daily basis, but starting from the third day of the apocalypse, a bag of cement can buy half a life.

Lin Yue took out his mobile phone from his pocket and took a photo of the shelf.Then he asked, "What's the quantity?"From the building materials section to the hardware section to the outdoor supplies section, he spent a full forty minutes carving into his mind the distribution map of available supplies in the entire supermarket.The lock on the unloading area door at the back of the warehouse is an old-fashioned mortise lock that can be fixed with a crowbar.The logistics channel leads directly to the back alley, which is three meters wide and can pass a light truck.

He stood at the door of the unloading area and deduced it in his mind.The first twelve hours after the apocalypse broke out was the most chaotic window period in the entire city. No one bothered to rob supermarkets, and everyone ran to hospitals and government buildings.That was the best time for him to take action.Using a truck and five people, the building materials area and half of the hardware area can be evacuated within an hour.

"Sir, do you need help?"

Lin Yue turned around.A young employee wearing a supermarket uniform was looking at him with some vigilance in his eyes.This person had been standing in the building materials area for almost 40 minutes, not only not looking to buy anything, but also taking photos. In the security manual of the warehouse supermarket, this behavior is called "stepping on the spot."

The judgment of "stepping on the spot" is accurate.It's just that this employee couldn't have guessed that he was stepping on the end of the world.

"No, thank you." Lin Yue said in a calm tone, "I am helping the company make a purchasing budget and need to check the inventory on the spot."

He turned the phone screen over and took a look at the other party - it was indeed the supply list he had just made.The guard on the employee's face relaxed a little, but he still looked at him twice before walking away.Lin Yue didn't care.There are still 58 hours left. Even if the employee calls the police and files a report, it will be too late to investigate him.

At 15:50, Lin Yue left the supermarket and drove home.

His residence is a rental apartment near the company, with one bedroom and one living room, 42 square meters, and the monthly rent is 2,300.When I opened the door, the entrance light was still on - I forgot to turn it off when I went out this morning.In his previous life, he always forgot to turn off the lights. Su Muqing had told him about this several times.She said that your monthly electricity bill is enough to buy three boxes of instant noodles. Before the apocalypse, he didn't take it seriously. After the apocalypse, he would have no more light to waste.

Lin Yue stood in the entrance hall and looked around the room.The T-shirt he changed out of yesterday was thrown on the sofa, a half bottle of Coke and a half-opened suspense novel were on the coffee table, and there were two bowls soaking in the kitchen sink.This is the normal life of a twenty-six-year-old ordinary office worker, undisciplined, comfortable, and unprepared.When he looked at these, he felt like he was watching another person's life.In a sense, it is indeed another person.

He walked into the bedroom and dug out a dusty hiking bag from the depths of the closet.Unzip the zipper and dump out the contents—old sneakers, some quick-dry clothes, a sleeping bag, a Swiss Army knife.These were all the equipment he saved while playing outdoors when he was in college in his previous life, and he never used them again after working.He picked out the ones he could use, threw away the rest, and placed the bag at the door.

Then there's money.

Lin Yue has a credit card limit of 50,000 yuan, a time deposit certificate of 80,000 yuan, and all the savings he has saved for three years of work - 120,000 yuan in a financial management account.Altogether, it’s less than three hundred thousand.This amount of money is quite a lot under normal circumstances, but it is far from enough to support what he will do next.

He needs a bigger sum of money.

The second-hand car dealer Lin met when he was driving a car specializes in mortgaged cars and urgent-sale cars. He takes in all kinds of cars without asking where they came from, and does not check the procedures. The transaction is in cash.After the outbreak of the apocalypse in the previous life, Lao Sun died very early - he tried to run out of the city in a newly mortgaged car on the second day of the virus outbreak, but was stopped by the military at the highway entrance. It was not because of the virus, but because the car was carrying a financial dispute and had been in the system for more than a year.The scene was chaotic and the soldier on duty was highly nervous. After a few quarrels, he was shot in the chest and died in the driver's seat.

It was the second day of the end of the world.Lin Yue was not at the scene at the time, but later heard from a survivor who escaped from the highway.

"Old Sun." When the call was connected, Lin Yue went straight to the point, "I have a car to sell. I picked it up early this year, white, automatic transmission, mileage 16,000. No accidents, complete procedures. Fixed price, 80,000. The deal must be completed before tomorrow."

Old Sun on the other end of the phone was stunned for a moment, and then laughed: "Brother Lin, 80,000? You don't know how much your new car will cost? You can't take me for granted at the fixed price. 60,000, I will pay you today."

"Seventy-five thousand. I want it today."

"Seventy thousand. No more. I'll take your car back and have it ready. If I resell it, I'll just make some hard money. Seventy thousand, I'll transfer it tonight. Will you pick up the car tomorrow?"

"Okay." Lin Yue didn't argue with him, "But I won't go to your store. You take the contract with you and come downstairs to me at eight o'clock tonight. I'll sign it in person and hand over the keys in person."

"Sure." Lao Sun agreed happily, "But Brother Lin, you are suddenly in a hurry to sell the car. What happened to you?"

Lin Yue didn't answer.He hung up the phone.

At 15:30, he started calling second-hand housing agencies to list his parents' house in his hometown for sale.The house in a neighboring city was the only inheritance left to him by his parents. He had not lived in it since graduation. He rented it out to a family of three and collected some rent every month to subsidize the mortgage.When the agent answered the phone, his tone was one of surprise - they like this kind of owners who are eager to sell, and the price is very low.But Lin Yue didn't give them the chance to lower the price.

"The base price is 600,000, non-negotiable. Those who can pay the full amount within three days will have priority in signing, and those who can't will be exempted from negotiation. The house will be put on the shelves this afternoon, and intensive inspections will be arranged tomorrow. I don't care what you do, I want to get the money before Monday."

"Mr. Lin, the time is indeed too tight. Where is the market price of your apartment type-"

"Six hundred thousand. If you can sell it, you can get the agency fee. If you can't, I'll find someone else."

"Okay, okay, I'll make arrangements right away."

Lin Yue hung up the phone and made a quick calculation in his mind.The car payment of 70,000 plus the salary balance of 47,000 is 117,000.If the house in my hometown can be sold as expected, 600,000 yuan will be available before Monday.Including credit cards and financial accounts, his wartime liquidity was probably more than 800,000.All this money must be spent within three days and turned into supplies.

Not enough.

But he had nothing more to cash in.
